detector_evidence.note: Frozen evidence store. The floor is a benchmark evidence-store floor, not a production acceptance threshold, not a ByteTrack threshold, and not a tuned tracking parameter.

LIBRARY_DEFAULTS.purpose: Measure out-of-the-box compatibility of trackers==2.6.0 with EyeCU detector scores.
LIBRARY_DEFAULTS.status: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY -- a production winner may not be declared from this profile alone.
LIBRARY_DEFAULTS.parameters: exact library defaults from the pinned 2.6.0 source; no confidence threshold altered

OCSORTTracker.low_pool_lower_bound: none -- detections below high_conf_det_threshold are discarded outright

EYECU_SCORE_POLICY_V1.purpose: Primary score-normalised comparison: how do the association algorithms compare when their detector-score interface is aligned to EyeCU's pre-existing accepted/candidate policy?
EYECU_SCORE_POLICY_V1.status: PRIMARY. Declared before identity GT exists; derived from EyeCU's existing detector interface, not from tracker performance.
EYECU_SCORE_POLICY_V1.detections_supplied_to_tracker: confidence > 0.10 (strict), taken from the frozen 0.01 evidence store

OCSORTTracker.note: OCSORTTracker exposes no track_activation_threshold in 2.6.0. No artificial second-stage pool is added; its hard filter simply moves from 0.6 to 0.25.

EYECU_SCORE_POLICY_V1.everything_else: library defaults -- matching thresholds, state estimator, lost_track_buffer, minimum_consecutive_frames, C-BIoU buffers, BoT-SORT CMC behaviour, appearance/ReID behaviour
EYECU_SCORE_POLICY_V1.frame_rate: actual source FPS per sequence (29.97 austin, 25.0 others). Metadata correctness, not tuning.
EYECU_SCORE_POLICY_V1.parameter_name_verification: Names above were read from the pinned 2.6.0 source (trackers/core/<name>/tracker.py), not assumed. Any name that fails to bind at runtime must STOP the bake-off rather than be guessed.

legacy_baseline.rule: NOT modified to imitate the normalised profile. It keeps its actual semantics, including the effective ~0.35 new-track gate (det_thresh = track_activation_threshold + 0.1) and its (0.10, 0.25) second-stage pool.
legacy_baseline.note: The hidden legacy 0.35 behaviour is NOT the EyeCU score policy and must not be copied into modern trackers.

constraints.no_copied_dataset_configs: SoccerNet / SportsMOT / MOT17 / DanceTrack tuned configs are forbidden
constraints.identical_inputs: every tracker receives the same frames, detections, confidences, image coordinates, source FPS and frame order

adoption_criteria.measured_on: EYECU_SCORE_POLICY_V1, end-to-end task, against identity GT
primary: combined HOTA improvement >= 2 absolute points over the legacy baseline
no sequence HOTA regression > 3 absolute points
invariants: accepted human detection semantics preserved (>= 0.25 boundary unchanged)
ball remains isolated from human association
all four detector classes preserved; goalkeeper never normalised to player
adoption_criteria.runtime: end-to-end regression <= 10% unless an accuracy gain is compelling and explicitly accepted
adoption_criteria.amendment_rule: These criteria may not be altered after any bake-off result is seen.

why_two_profiles.LIBRARY_DEFAULTS: How well does the package work out of the box with EyeCU scores?
why_two_profiles.EYECU_SCORE_POLICY_V1: How do the association algorithms compare when their detector-score interface is aligned to EyeCU's pre-existing accepted/candidate policy?
why_two_profiles.not_post_result_tuning: The score policy is declared before identity GT results exist and is derived from EyeCU's existing detector interface, not from tracker performance.
